description: This file is a shell script named 'check-builtins.sh' that performs validation of built-in command support in a Git-related environment. It generates a list of built-ins, compares them against a command list in 'git.c', and checks for associated auxiliary scripts, reporting inconsistencies.

methods.name: main validation loop
methods.description: Reads the list of built-ins, verifies their presence in 'git.c', and checks for associated scripts in 'sh', 'perl', and 'py' formats, reporting issues.
